_readme: v10 CONFIG — Variation A restructure. Exact calibration values from config_v6_rel_pop.json. Structure only changes. 17 top-level keys → 7. Do not modify values without updating calibration notes.

model_name.notes: Discrete-time stochastic population model with childhood pool and sexual debut

version.notes: V13.1: migrant HIV entry seeding adds documented pre-arrival diagnosed HIV-positive migrants as a subset of positive net migration. V13.0: residence-time queue aging replaces memoryless fractional aging in production; fractional_legacy retained for diagnostics. V12.19: deterministic event allocation consistency. V12.x: diagnosis schedules, LHS pipeline upgrades, HTA/reporting hardening. V11.x: HTA module, economics/adverse-events refactor, route-specific transmission betas, parameter tiers, contact balance fix, Garnett epsilon parameterisation.

model_notes.calibration_status: V13.14 DIAGNOSTIC — 1975 burn-in feasibility. NOT production. Based on V13.10 best fit abc_smc_best_fit_rank_001.json.
model_notes.intended_use: Thesis research on HIV prevention interventions
model_notes.population_flow: Birth → Childhood pool (age 0–14, sex only) → Sexual debut (age 15) → Orientation + Activity assignment → HIV transmission system
model_notes.academic_framing: A discrete-time stochastic population model for HIV transmission dynamics and prevention interventions, developed from scratch for the Netherlands context with modern computational best practices.

start_year.notes: V13.14: diagnostic 1975 start for historical burn-in. Production remains 1980.

step_size.notes: Number of units per timestep (3 months = quarterly step)

n_runs.notes: Stochastic simulation runs. Use 100+ for uncertainty analysis.

deterministic_mode.notes: Replace random draws with expected values. Use for debugging/testing only.

enabled.notes: Master switch for writing output files

write_per_run_files.notes: Write one output file per simulation run

write_aggregated_files.notes: Write mean/quantile summary across runs (requires n_runs > 1)

terminal_summary.notes: Print summary table to terminal at end of simulation

write_state_counts.notes: Write full stratified state counts — produces very large files. Enable only for detailed diagnostics.

summary_years.notes: Calendar years included in the terminal summary table

quantiles.notes: Quantiles for aggregated outputs (5th percentile, median, 95th percentile)

initialization_method.notes: How the initial population is constructed: 'relative_weights' (scale from age-sex shares) or 'absolute_counts' (direct cell values)

total_size.notes: Total population at simulation start. Source: Human Mortality Database (HMD) Netherlands Jan 1, 1975. V13.14 diagnostic — production uses 1980 value (14,090,318).
total_size.source: Human Mortality Database (HMD). Netherlands population Jan 1 1975. https://www.mortality.org/Country/Country?cntr=NLD

initial_hiv_prevalence.notes: HIV not present in the Netherlands in 1970. Set to 0.0. Epidemic introduction is modelled via the epidemic_seed block. V12.4.

p_msm.notes: Proportion of males assigned MSM orientation at sexual debut
p_msm.calibration_target: Estimated proportion of sexually active Dutch males who are MSM (EMIS Netherlands 2017/2022; CBS population surveys; RIVM SOA Monitor MSM population size estimates).
p_msm.source: EMIS-2017 Netherlands country report. Davidovich U et al. (2001) STI 77:37-42 (Dutch MSM population size estimates).

activity_distribution.notes: Relative weights for sexual activity level assignment at debut. Must sum to 1.0.

age_sex_distribution.notes: Relative age-sex weight shares for initial population. Source: Human Mortality Database (HMD) Netherlands, Jan 1 1975. V13.14 diagnostic — production uses 1980 weights.

enabled.notes: Master switch for time-gated epidemic introduction. Set false for pre-epidemic counterfactual runs.

seed_year.notes: V13.14 diagnostic: seed year set to 1975 for burn-in testing. Probes test 1975, 1977, and 1980 variants. Original production value: 1980.
seed_year.source: Coutinho RA (1998) JAIDS 17(Suppl.1):S4-S8. Coutinho RA et al. (1986) Genitourin Med 62:38-43.

seed_prevalence.notes: Proportion of seeded subpopulation with HIV at seed_year. ELISA testing unavailable pre-1985; prevalence at introduction unknowable. Placeholder value — must be fitted to Dutch epidemic trajectory. No reliable literature prior.
seed_prevalence.calibration_target: Dutch early epidemic trajectory and cumulative diagnosed HIV cases after introduction; fitted during historical calibration.
seed_prevalence.source: Calibration target. Pre-1985 testing absence is a documented model limitation.

msm_fraction.notes: Fraction of seed cases allocated to MSM orientation. 0=fully heterosexual, 1=fully MSM. Dutch early epidemic was predominantly MSM-driven but exact fraction of undetected cases is unknown. Placeholder — must be calibrated. No reliable literature prior due to pre-1985 testing absence.
msm_fraction.calibration_target: Dutch MSM-specific share of early HIV diagnoses and subsequent MSM incidence trajectory.
msm_fraction.source: Calibration target. Coutinho RA (1998) JAIDS 17(Suppl.1):S4-S8 (MSM-predominant early epidemic).

seed_stage.notes: HIV compartment for seed cases. 'Acute'=biologically correct for introduction event (new infections). 'Chronic'=established infections (sensitivity testing only).
seed_stage.source: Hollingsworth TD et al. (2008) J Infect Dis 198:687-693 (acute phase biology).

stage_distribution.notes: V13.7 LHS-derived fixed-total epidemic seed stage distribution.

enabled.notes: If false, population is static — no births, background aging, or non-HIV mortality

mode.notes: Birth generation mode: 'closed' (no births), 'fixed_net_addition' (constant annual entrants), 'fertility_table' (age-specific fertility rates)

enabled.notes: Pre-sexual childhood pool. Children progress through 0–4, 5–9, 10–14 before sexual debut. NOT part of the HIV transmission system.

age_bins.notes: Childhood 5-year bins from birth to debut age. Must align with age_sex_distribution childhood rows.

initial_per_bin.notes: 'auto' derives initial childhood counts from population.total_size and population.age_sex_distribution. Or provide explicit {'male': N, 'female': N} per bin.

background_mortality_annual.notes: Flat annual child mortality fallback — used only when demography.life_table.enabled = false
background_mortality_annual.source: Derived from CBS/RIVM life tables (Netherlands 2015-2019). Flat fallback only — active when life_table.enabled = false.

debut_age.notes: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — not read by engine, hard-coded to first adult age bin (15–19). Update if age bins change.

p_msm.notes: Proportion of debuting males assigned MSM orientation for ongoing birth cohorts. Note: population.p_msm controls the initial stock distribution. Koedijk et al. (2014), De Graaf (2012)
p_msm.calibration_target: Estimated proportion of sexually active Dutch males who are MSM. Applied to ongoing birth cohorts at sexual debut.
p_msm.source: EMIS-2017 Netherlands country report. Davidovich U et al. (2001) STI 77:37-42.

use_population_activity_distribution.notes: Assign debut activity levels using same distribution as existing population (recommended). Set false only with explicit custom weights — misalignment causes distributional drift.

enabled.notes: Override flat background mortality with age-sex specific annual survival rates. Strongly recommended — flat rate is a coarse approximation.

survival_by_age_limit.notes: Piecewise annual survival probabilities from birth to each age_limit. Bin rate = (lx_B / lx_A)^0.2 for 5-year bins. Source: Human Mortality Database (HMD), Netherlands, period life tables 2015–2019, protocol v6. URL: https://www.mortality.org/Country/Country?cntr=NLD

fraction_male_newborns.notes: Sex ratio at birth (proportion male). Source: CBS Netherlands historical average. 54-year average (0.4957) .
fraction_male_newborns.source: CBS StatLine. Netherlands live births by sex 1970-2020. Mean male fraction 0.512 (range 0.510-0.514). https://opendata.cbs.nl/statline/ table 37422.

asfr_by_age_limit.notes: Annual births per woman-year, piecewise by 5-year age band (age-specific fertility rates). Assumption: fertility = 0 after age 50. Source: Human Fertility Collection (fertilitydata.org), Netherlands ASFR standardised. URL: https://www.fertilitydata.org/Country/Country?code=NLD

enabled.notes: Scale baseline ASFR by calendar year to match historical TFR trajectory. Disable for a constant fertility scenario.

values.notes: TFR scaling multipliers by calendar year (linearly interpolated). Age bins 1 and 9 excluded from multiplier derivation. Historical sources: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) — https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb/figures/detail/86244ENG | Macrotrends NLD birth rate — https://www.macrotrends.net/global-metrics/countries/nld/netherlands/birth-rate. Forecast anchors from CBS population forecast TFR, divided by baseline TFR 1.621.

enabled.notes: Net migration module. Entrants are Susceptible / Undiagnosed / No-ART / No-PrEP. Safe default: false (disabled). Set true to activate.

mode.notes: Active quantity mode. Exactly one is used: 'year_specific' | 'rate' | 'flat'

year_specific.notes: Annual net migration figures by calendar year. Missing years default to 0. Historical source: World Bank, Netherlands net migration 1970–2020, plus observed/provisional recent values through 2024. Forecast source: CBS population forecast central net migration incl. net administrative corrections, linearly interpolated between 2025, 2030, 2040, 2050, 2060, and 2070 anchors. URL: https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SM.POP.NETM?locations=NL

rate.notes: Annual net migration as fraction of current total population. Only used when quantity.mode = 'rate'. E.g. 0.003 = 0.3%/yr. NL historical average.

flat.notes: Constant annual net migrants (persons/year). Only used when quantity.mode = 'flat'. NL historical average ~44,000/yr.

mode.notes: How entrant migrants are distributed across age-sex bins. 'mirror' (match current population) | 'working_age' (concentrate in prime working ages) | 'custom' (explicit weights)

min_age.notes: Youngest age (inclusive) for working-age migrant profile. Only used when profile.mode = 'working_age'.

max_age.notes: Oldest age (inclusive, at bin boundary) for working-age migrant profile. Only used when profile.mode = 'working_age'.

custom_weights.notes: Explicit per-bin age-sex weights. Auto-normalised. Only used when profile.mode = 'custom'. Example covers prime working/fertility ages. Extend to cover all desired bins.

enabled.notes: V13.1: documented pre-arrival HIV-positive migrants are allocated as a subset of positive net migration, not added as extra population.

count_mode.notes: Annual source counts by arrival year. Years outside year_specific_counts and fallback_years default to zero.

year_specific_counts.notes: SHM HIV Monitoring Report 2025: 1,337 people arrived in 2022-2024 with documented HIV-1 diagnosis prior to arrival; 641 arrived in 2022 and 302 in 2024, so 2023 is residual 394. Figure 1.2 is not digitized.

fallback_count.notes: Backcast count applied only over fallback_years, based on SHM 2025 statement that the average annual number of pre-arrival diagnosed migrants in other years in 2018-2024 was 322.

fallback_years.notes: Inclusive arrival-year window where fallback_count is used when no year_specific_counts entry is available. Years outside this window remain zero unless explicitly added.

orientation_distribution.notes: SHM 2022-2024 split: 49% MSM, 21% other men, 26% women, 4% trans. Current model maps trans to MSM; source trans count remains documented in disease data.

hiv_stage_distribution.notes: Pre-arrival diagnosed migrants are represented as established chronic HIV entries. Acute importation and AIDS-stage late presentation are deferred.

diagnosis_distribution.notes: All entries in this mechanism have documented HIV diagnosis before arrival.

art_distribution.notes: SHM reports 90% started ART before arrival. V13.1 uses a simple 90/10 split and does not separately parameterize 3% starting in the Netherlands plus 7% uncertain timing.

prep_state.notes: HIV-positive migrant entries have no PrEP state.

aging_method.notes: Population aging method. 'fractional'/'residence_queue' = residence-time queue through 5-year bins (production). 'fractional_legacy' = old memoryless transfer retained for diagnostics. 'discrete' = 100% transfer every 5 years (legacy).

background_mortality.notes: Flat annual non-HIV mortality fallback for sexually active adults. Only applied when life_table.enabled = false. Coarse approximation life_table is strongly preferred.

annual_entrants.notes: Births per year entering childhood pool at age 0. Only used when demography.mode = 'fixed_net_addition'.

enabled.notes: Apply exogenous year-by-year scaling multipliers to total population. For calibration passes only not a scenario lever.

compartment_scope.notes: Which compartments the year multipliers are applied to. 'susceptible_only' scales only HIV-negative individuals not on PrEP HIV+ compartments grow exclusively via transmission. 'all' scales the entire tensor (calibration use only).

apply_to.notes: Scope of adjustment: 'total', 'by_age', 'by_orientation', or 'by_age_and_orientation' NOTE: other features are not implemented

year_multipliers.notes: Population scaling factors by calendar year (interpolated). Source: Worldometers Netherlands population https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/netherlands-population/

orientations.notes: Sexual orientation groups. Assigned at sexual debut NOT at birth.

value.name: MSM
value.notes: Men who have sex with men

age_groups.notes: Sexually active age groups (5-year bins). Children 0-14 are in demography.childhood and are NOT part of the transmission system.

sexual_activity_groups.notes: Activity strata assigned at debut. contact_rate per-act beta = force of infection. Assigned at debut NOT at birth.

hiv_stages.notes: HIV disease stages. DO NOT MODIFY ORDER indices map directly to the engine's population tensor dimensions.

value.name: Acute
value.notes: Recent infection high viral load, peak infectivity

value.name: Chronic
value.notes: Established infection lower VL, lower infectivity

value.name: AIDS
value.notes: Advanced disease elevated VL, high mortality

orientation_contact_multipliers.notes: Calibration multipliers on base contact rates by orientation. Heterosexual_Male is the calibration reference at 1.0; Female is expected to be lower and MSM higher. Defaults to 1.0 for any unlisted orientation. Introduced in V9 patch — do not modify without recalibrating betas.

epsilon_hetero.notes: Assortativity of heterosexual mixing by sexual activity class (Garnett 1994 formula). 0 = fully proportional (random); 1 = fully assortative (same class only). Dutch starting value 0.20 — lower than sub-Saharan Africa estimates (0.30-0.40, Garnett & Anderson 1994) reflecting the smaller, less activity-stratified Dutch heterosexual HIV network (RIVM SOA Monitor; van der Sande et al. 2008). Tier 2 estimated — calibrate against Dutch incidence.
epsilon_hetero.calibration_target: Dutch heterosexual HIV incidence trend 1985-2015 (RIVM SOA Monitor; Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu annual HIV/STI surveillance reports; van Sighem AI et al. HIV Monitoring Report NL).
epsilon_hetero.source: Garnett GP, Anderson RM (1994) J Acquir Immune Defic Syndr 7(11):1181-1192 (Garnett formula). Dutch starting value 0.20 lower than sub-Saharan estimates (0.30-0.40) reflecting smaller Dutch heterosexual HIV network (van der Sande MA et al. 2008 AIDS 22:511-518; RIVM SOA Monitor).

epsilon_msm.notes: Assortativity of MSM mixing by sexual activity class (Garnett 1994 formula). 0 = fully proportional (random); 1 = fully assortative. Dutch starting value 0.42 — calibrated to Amsterdam MSM cohort network structure (Xiridou et al. 2003 AIDS 17:1029-1038; Amsterdam Cohort Studies activity-class mixing). Tier 2 estimated — calibrate against Dutch MSM-specific incidence. BACKLOG: Discuss whether to constrain epsilon_msm == epsilon_hetero or estimate separately. Currently estimated separately (+1 DF). Justified by structural difference in MSM vs heterosexual networks but increases collinearity with MSM orientation multiplier.
epsilon_msm.calibration_target: Dutch MSM HIV incidence trend 1985-2015 (ATHENA cohort; van Sighem AI et al. Stichting HIV Monitoring annual reports).
epsilon_msm.source: Xiridou M et al. (2003) AIDS 17(7):1029-1038 (Amsterdam MSM cohort; activity-class mixing structure). Starting value 0.42 calibrated to Amsterdam Cohort Studies network activity patterns.

condom_usage.notes: Risk multiplier by activity group applied as: effective_beta = beta × condom_mod. 1.0 = no condom effect (current default  all groups). 0.5 = 50% risk reduction. Currently dormant. Activate by setting values < 1.0 and recalibrating betas.

beta_acute.notes: Per-act HIV transmission probability acute stage (peak viral load)

beta_chronic.notes: Per-act HIV transmission probability chronic stage

beta_aids.notes: Per-act HIV transmission probability AIDS stage (elevated VL due to immunosuppression)

distribution.notes: Beta fitted to 95% CI [0.0006, 0.0011]. Boily 2009 Table 1 HIC M-F pooled estimate (10 studies).DONE

chronic.notes: M-F vaginal receptive, HIC, asymptomatic/chronic phase
chronic.calibration_target: Dutch heterosexual HIV incidence stratified by sex (RIVM annual STI surveillance report); literature anchor Boily 2009 HIC M-F pooled estimate

distribution.notes: Beta J Shape. LogNormal alt -->[mu_log': -7.89, 'sigma_log': 0.67] to 95% CI [0.0001, 0.0014]. Boily 2009 Table 1 HIC FtM pooled estimate (3 studies). Wide CI reflects limited data.

chronic.notes: F-M vaginal insertive, HIC, asymptomatic/chronic phase
chronic.calibration_target: Dutch heterosexual HIV incidence stratified by sex (RIVM annual STI surveillance report); literature anchor Boily 2009 HIC F-M pooled estimate

distribution.notes: Beta fitted to 95% CI [0.0102, 0.0186]. URAI pooled estimate from Baggaley 2010 via Patel 2014. DONE

chronic.notes: URAI (unprotected receptive anal intercourse), asymptomatic/chronic phase
chronic.calibration_target: Dutch MSM HIV incidence (RIVM annual STI surveillance report / Amsterdam Cohort Studies); literature anchor Baggaley 2010 URAI pooled estimate via Patel 2014

distribution.notes: Beta fitted to 95% CI [0.0004, 0.0028]. UIAI pooled estimate combining CHSS (Vittinghoff 1999) and HIM study.DONE

chronic.calibration_target: Dutch MSM HIV incidence (RIVM annual STI surveillance report / Amsterdam Cohort Studies); literature anchor Vittinghoff 1999 CHSS + HIM study via Patel 2014

distribution.notes: LogNormal fitted to 95% CI [4.47, 18.81]. Meta-regression RR early vs asymptomatic (14 study estimates, within-study comparisons). DONE.

stage_multiplier_acute.notes: Relative risk of transmission in acute/early stage vs asymptomatic. Applied to all routes.

distribution.notes: LogNormal fitted to 95% CI [4.45, 11.88]. Meta-regression RR late/AIDS vs asymptomatic (within-study comparisons). DONE

stage_multiplier_aids.notes: Relative risk of transmission in AIDS/late stage vs asymptomatic. Applied to all routes.

msm_versatility.notes: P(susceptible is receptive | MSM contact). Governs Bernoulli split of MSM contacts into URAI vs UIAI. Memoryless.

acute_to_chronic.notes: Annual probability of progression from acute chronic HIV (untreated)
acute_to_chronic.source: Hollingsworth TD et al. (2008) J Infect Dis 198(5):687-693 (acute phase duration ~2-10 months; central estimate ~3 months annual rate 0.5 for quarterly model). Cohen MS et al. (2011) NEJM 365:493-505 (HPTN052).

chronic_to_aids.notes: Annual probability of progression from chronic to AIDS (untreated / not virally suppressed) . Source: CASCADE 2000 collaboration. Median time to AIDS 9.8 yrs [95:9.5-10.1], ages 25-34, CASCADE Table 2. Main analyses to age 25-29 as the reference category.
chronic_to_aids.source: CASCADE Collaboration (2000) Determinants of survival following HIV-1 seroconversion after the introduction of HAART. Lancet 362(9392):1267-1274. ATHENA cohort off-ART progression data (van Sighem AI et al. 2015 HIV Monitoring Report Netherlands).

chronic_to_aids_on_art.notes: Annual probability of chronic AIDS while on ART with viral suppression. ~10 reduction vs untreated. Source: Mocroft et al. 2010, CASCADE collaboration.
chronic_to_aids_on_art.source: NEED DIST BLOCK????? Mocroft A et al. (2010) Changes in the cause of death among HIV positive subjects across Europe: results from the EuroSIDA study. AIDS 24(10):1569-1579. CASCADE on-ART data; ~10-fold reduction vs untreated progression.

acute.source: Acute-stage HIV mortality is low; most deaths occur in AIDS stage. Estimate derived from CASCADE early-stage mortality data.

distribution.notes: Beta fitted to 95% CI [0.1, 0.3]. Glaubius 250-349 Band for age 25-34. DONE
Beta fitted to 95% CI [0.1992, 0.2444]. Glaubius 25-34, 3 band weighted chaining derivation pipeline.DONE

combine_with_background.notes: How HIV mortality interacts with background mortality. 'excess' = HIV mortality added on top of background (additive). 'override' = HIV mortality replaces background.

annual_rate.notes: Flat fallback used when no schedule block is present.
annual_rate.source: Fallback diagnosis parameter retained for compatibility; active runs use the calendar-year diagnosis schedule when present.

interpolation.notes: 'stepwise' = carry-forward; 'linear' = linear interpolation between anchor years.

schedule.source: van Sighem AI et al. (2015) HIV Monitoring Report Netherlands. Stichting HIV Monitoring (SHM). ECDC HIV/AIDS Surveillance Report 2021 (Netherlands undiagnosed fraction estimates).

enabled.notes: Production feature flag. Default false preserves the V13.18 basecase common-diagnosis path; set true to apply the MSM-relative diagnosis multipliers below. V13.21 allows multipliers above 1.0; the derived annual probability and final timestep probability are capped.

interpolation.notes: Use 'stepwise' for era-based carry-forward multipliers or 'linear' for interpolation between anchor years.

msm_relative_diagnosis.notes: V13.20 production-configured MSM relative diagnosis/ascertainment layer, with V13.21 runtime semantics. When enabled, multiplies the base diagnosis schedule for MSM only; non-MSM groups use the base diagnosis schedule unchanged. Multipliers may be below, equal to, or above 1.0; the derived annual diagnosis probability and final timestep probability are capped at 1.0. V13.18 rank-001 multiplier values retained, but the production default is disabled for backward-compatible basecase runs.
msm_relative_diagnosis.source: van der Bij AK, Dukers NHTM, Coutinho RA, Fennema HSA. Low HIV-testing rates and awareness of HIV infection among high-risk heterosexual STI clinic attendees in The Netherlands. European Journal of Public Health. 2008;18(4):376-379. doi:10.1093/eurpub/ckm105. Used as Netherlands-context evidence that HIV-testing uptake and awareness differ by risk group, supporting an explicit feature-flagged MSM-relative ascertainment layer.

art_transmission_reduction.notes: Proportional reduction in transmission probability when patient is on ART (96% = Undetectable = Untransmittable, per Nichols 2016). Xirdou 74.5% (50-99), but older study.
art_transmission_reduction.source: Cohen MS et al. (2011) Prevention of HIV-1 Infection with Early Antiretroviral Therapy. NEJM 365:493-505 (HPTN052; 96% reduction). Rodger AJ et al. (2019) Risk of HIV transmission through condomless sex in serodifferent gay couples with the HIV-positive partner taking suppressive antiretroviral therapy (PARTNER): final results. Lancet 393(10189):2428-2438 (0 transmissions observed).

art_mortality_reduction.notes: Proportional reduction in HIV-attributable mortality when on ART (90% reduction vs untreated). Update only when adopting new clinical evidence.

distribution.notes: Beta(18, 2); mean=0.9. ART-CC cohort studies show 70-95% reduction in HIV-attributable mortality; central estimate 0.90. Less uncertain than betas but not constrained as tightly as HPTN052.

art_mortality_reduction.source: Antiretroviral Therapy Cohort Collaboration (ART-CC) (2010) Life expectancy of individuals on combination antiretroviral therapy in high-income countries: a collaborative analysis of 14 cohort studies. Lancet 372(9635):293-299.

enabled.notes: ART availability in the simulation. Set false for a pre-ART counterfactual (all years). To model ART introduction at a specific year, use the initiation schedule (rates = 0 before first schedule entry).

interpolation.notes: How rates are applied between schedule years. 'stepwise' = carry last known value forward. 'linear' = interpolate between anchor years.

initiation.notes: Annual probability of ART initiation for a diagnosed, untreated individual by calendar year. Before 1996: ART unavailable (implicit zero). Source: calibrated to ECDC/RIVM Netherlands ART coverage data.

art_dropout_rate.notes: Annual probability of discontinuing ART (flat rate — time-varying schedule not yet implemented, see backlog CONFIG-5). Currently applied uniformly across all years.

enabled.notes: Enable oral PrEP intervention. False = no PrEP in this run.

uptake_rate.notes: Annual probability of initiating oral PrEP for a susceptible individual (baseline rate before activity modifier)

dropout_rate.notes: Annual probability of discontinuing oral PrEP

efficacy.notes: Protection per dosing cycle with adherence (86% effectiveness). Source: iPrEx / PROUD / IPERGAY trials.
efficacy.source: Grant RM et al. (2010) Preexposure Chemoprophylaxis for HIV Prevention in Men Who Have Sex with Men. NEJM 363:2587-2599 (iPrEx; 44% ITT, ~86% with high adherence). McCormack S et al. (2016) Pre-exposure prophylaxis to prevent the acquisition of HIV-1 infection (PROUD). Lancet 387(10013):53-60.

dosing_interval.notes: Prescription renewal interval (3 months = quarterly). Determines how often coverage is re-evaluated.

uptake_modifier_by_activity.notes: V11.5: IMPLEMENTED. Multiplier on baseline uptake_rate by sexual activity class for historical oral PrEP calibration. Low-activity MSM remain nonzero because real PrEP indication includes situational risk not captured by fixed activity class; Medium is the reference and High has higher uptake intensity.

eligible_orientations.notes: V11.5: Which orientation groups can initiate this PrEP type. Dutch guidelines: PrEP primarily indicated for MSM at substantial HIV risk. Add 'Female' or 'Heterosexual_Male' to expand eligibility. If absent, defaults to all orientations (backward compat).

eligible_age_range.notes: V11.5: Age groups eligible for PrEP initiation. Initiation only — existing users who age past max are NOT forced off PrEP. If absent, defaults to full age range (backward compat).

eligible_activity_classes.notes: V11.5.1: Which sexual activity classes can initiate this PrEP type. Default is all classes. For HTA scenario targeting, restrict to e.g. ['High'] to model reimbursement criteria limited to highest-risk individuals. This is a regulatory/eligibility gate — use uptake_modifier_by_activity for within-eligible uptake intensity differences. If absent, defaults to all activity classes (backward compat).

enabled.notes: Enable injectable Lenacapavir (6-monthly dosing). False = not modelled in this run.

uptake_rate.notes: Annual probability of initiating Lenacapavir for a susceptible individual

efficacy.notes: Efficacy of Lenacapavir vs background HIV incidence (unprotected individuals). Derived from PURPOSE-2 (MSM/TGW/TGM/GNB, the relevant trial for NL context): LEN incidence rate 0.103/100PY (95%CI 0.012-0.373) vs estimated background incidence (bHIV via RITA) 2.374/100PY. Efficacy = 1 - (0.103/2.374) = 0.957. PSA bounds [0.843, 0.995] derived from PURPOSE-2 LEN rate 95%CI endpoints: upper CI 0.373/100PY -> efficacy 0.843; lower CI 0.012/100PY -> efficacy 0.995. CHMP caveat: bHIV estimated via RITA is flagged as potentially unreliable as primary evidence (EMA/265754/2025 s.9.1.2 and s.10.3.1); SmPC s.5.1 reports only LEN vs TVD secondary analysis. Thesis primary analysis uses bHIV-derived efficacy with LEN vs TVD sensitivity (RR 0.111, PURPOSE-2). PURPOSE-1 (AGYW, sub-Saharan Africa) excluded as primary source: population not representative of NL MSM.

distribution._notes: Beta(25, 1.1) approximates PURPOSE-2 CI-derived uncertainty: mean=0.958, heavily right-skewed reflecting near-ceiling efficacy. Alpha/beta derived via moment matching to target mean 0.957 with SD~0.039. Bounds [0.843, 0.995] applied as hard clips in PSA sampler.

efficacy.source: EMA CHMP Assessment Report, Yeytuo (lenacapavir), EMA/265754/2025, Table 63, 24 July 2025. PURPOSE-2 trial (GS-US-528-9023): LEN 2/2179 participants, 0.103/100PY (95%CI 0.012-0.373); bHIV 2.374/100PY (RITA estimate). PURPOSE-1 (GS-US-412-5624): LEN 0/2134, 0.000/100PY (95%CI 0.000-0.190) vs bHIV 2.407/100PY — reported for completeness; not used as primary parameter source (AGYW population).

uptake_modifier_by_activity.notes: BACKLOG — NOT YET IMPLEMENTED IN ENGINE. Intended multiplier on baseline uptake_rate by sexual activity class for injectable Lenacapavir, allowing risk-stratified uptake (e.g. High-activity individuals 2x more likely to seek long-acting injectable PrEP). Currently the engine applies a uniform uptake_rate across all activity classes regardless of these values. Wire into _step_prep_transitions() when Lenacapavir is activated. Normalised to Medium = 1.0.

eligible_orientations.notes: V11.5: MSM only (Dutch PrEP demand context). PURPOSE-1 enrolled cisgender women; PURPOSE-2 enrolled MSM/transgender. Expand via scenario overrides if broader eligibility explored.

eligible_age_range.notes: V11.5: Age groups eligible for Lenacapavir initiation. Initiation only — existing users who age past max are NOT forced off. If absent, defaults to full age range (backward compat).

eligible_activity_classes.notes: V11.5.1: Which sexual activity classes can initiate Lenacapavir. Default is all MSM activity classes. For HTA Scenario B (targeted), override to ['High'] to restrict to highest-risk MSM only — reflecting ZIN reimbursement criteria. If absent, defaults to all activity classes (backward compat).

waning_efficacy.notes: Efficacy of Lenacapavir_Waning state — matches active efficacy. Rationale: LEN plasma concentrations remain >4x EC95 throughout the full 6-month dosing window (EPAR EMA/265754/2025, clinical pharmacology section). No pharmacological basis for reduced protection within the approved dosing interval. Not a PSA parameter (fixed = active efficacy value).
waning_efficacy.source: EMA CHMP Assessment Report, Yeytuo (lenacapavir), EMA/265754/2025, s.6.2 (PK/PD conclusions). Bekker LG et al. (2024) Lenacapavir for HIV Prevention in Women. NEJM Evidence 2024.

interpolation.notes: V11.5: How PrEP rates are applied between schedule years. 'stepwise' = carry last known value forward. 'linear' = interpolate between anchor years.

historical_stock_corridor.notes: Historical CSG oral PrEP stock corridor for 2019-2025 calibration and baseline construction. Floors prevent demographic/LHS draws from collapsing observed historical PrEP exposure; ceilings prevent per-capita uptake from generating implausible historical stocks. Floor/ceiling values are broad guardrails around RIVM programme stock/care anchors, not HTA forward uptake assumptions.

initiation.notes: V11.5: Annual PrEP initiation probability for eligible susceptible individuals (Medium-activity baseline rate). 2019: Dutch national PrEP programme began. Rates are PLACEHOLDER values pending calibration against RIVM PrEP monitoring reports. Source reference: Hoornenborg et al. (2019) Lancet HIV 6:e790-e798 (AMPrEP study).

discontinuation.notes: V11.5: Annual PrEP discontinuation probability. Fitted in historical calibration rather than anchored to CSG LTFU, because LTFU may include continued PrEP through GP/private/informal channels.

historical_stock_corridor.notes: Generic corridor mechanism is available for lenacapavir, but disabled for historical Netherlands calibration because lenacapavir was not available before the HTA fork.

initiation.notes: Lenacapavir as PrEPnot yet available in Netherlands. Scenario overrides will populate this for HTA evaluation.

v13_14_diagnostic.limitation: 1975 age-sex distribution uses HMD observed data. Life tables, fertility rates, and TFR multipliers are unchanged from production (2015-2019 average life table, modern ASFR). This is a known limitation — period-specific demographic inputs for 1975-1980 are not separately validated. Acceptable for diagnostic burn-in testing.

fixed_parameters.name: art_init_1995
fixed_parameters.reason: Hard no-ART anchor before the 1996 ART availability year.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_oral_prep_enabled
fixed_parameters.reason: Historical oral PrEP remains active for 2019-2025 targets.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_lenacapavir_disabled
fixed_parameters.reason: Lenacapavir was unavailable during historical calibration.

fixed_parameters.name: msm_relative_diagnosis_enabled
fixed_parameters.reason: V13.10 diagnostic pilot: activates the MSM relative diagnosis layer. This fixed parameter ensures the feature is on for every particle in this space. Not a production default.

fixed_parameters.name: simulation_start_year
fixed_parameters.reason: V13.14 diagnostic: simulation starts in 1975 for historical burn-in. Scoring window remains 1990+ via --scoring-start-year runner flag.

fixed_parameters.name: seed_year
fixed_parameters.reason: V13.14 default seed year. For seed_1977 and seed_1980 variants, override this fixed parameter in separate run configs.
